tools.name: list_exams
tools.title: List exams
tools.description: List the signed-in user's generated exams (title, status, score, difficulty, dates). Use get_exam to fetch an exam's full questions.

status.description: Filter by exam status. 'pending' means not yet taken.

limit.description: Maximum number of exams to return.

tools.name: get_exam
tools.title: Get exam with questions
tools.description: Fetch one exam of the signed-in user together with all its questions (text, options, correct answer, explanation, source excerpt). Use list_exams first to find the exam id.

exam_id.description: The exam id returned by list_exams.

tools.name: list_weak_questions
tools.title: List mistake bank
tools.description: List the signed-in user's mistake bank (weak questions): which questions they got wrong, how often, and whether they are mastered. Includes the question text and explanation.

mastered.description: Filter by mastery. Default shows only not-yet-mastered questions.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return.

tools.name: list_sources
tools.title: List study sources
tools.description: List the signed-in user's uploaded study sources (documents used to generate exams). Returns titles and metadata, not full document text.

tools.name: get_study_stats
tools.title: Get study stats
tools.description: Summarize the signed-in user's study activity: number of exams, completed exams, average score, mistake-bank size, mastered questions, and number of uploaded sources.
